scope: For the actual periodic SU(2) Wilson one-link conditional laws, every global local-influence matrix C satisfies axisMean(12*beta)<=sum_j C(i,j). Haar concentration gives 1-1/(8*beta)<=sum_j C(i,j) for beta>0. Any row upper bound alpha therefore satisfies (1-alpha)*beta<=1/8; no common alpha<1 works along beta->infinity, even with changing periods. Nonnegative majorants with weights>=1 obey the same obstruction. The constant +1 and -1 endpoints are proved gauge equivalent on even periods, and every gauge-invariant observable agrees there. This rules out a fixed microscopic comparison margin, not shrinking margins, a physical mass gap, or physical-scale coarse estimates. The continuum limit and all twelve Clay obligations remain open.

actual_law_calculation.configurations: Every link equals q in SU(2): every plaquette action term is zero and the actual six-staple field is exactly 6*q.
actual_law_calculation.test: probe(q)=Re(q), continuous with absolute value<=1 and oscillation<=2; it is not invariant under left multiplication.
actual_law_calculation.conditional_mean: The genuine Wilson coordinate conditional at the all-q exterior has probe expectation axisMean(12*beta)*probe(q).
actual_law_calculation.row_bound: Apply the actual LocalInfluence predicate to this test and telescope between all +1 and all -1 coordinate configurations. The total mean difference is 2*axisMean(12*beta), forcing axisMean(12*beta)<=sum_j C(i,j).
actual_law_calculation.margin: If sum_j C(i,j)<=alpha then (1-alpha)*beta<=1/8. A fixed alpha<1 forces beta<=1/(8*(1-alpha)).
actual_law_calculation.trajectory: For beta_k->infinity, every fixed alpha<1 is eventually exceeded by each selected row, even for varying finite periods N_k>1. Weights>=1 cannot improve a nonnegative majorant.

gauge_scope.even_period: The actual alternating central gauge g(x)=(-1)^(sum of periodic coordinate parities) sends the constant +1 configuration to constant -1.
gauge_scope.consequence: Every gauge-invariant observable takes the same value on the two endpoints. The test witnessing the row obstruction measures raw link orientation.
gauge_scope.restriction: The coordinate telescoping path need not stay within a good-field domain. The theorem is global; it does not exclude estimates restricted to good fields or to gauge-invariant observables.

not_proved: Rows are not proved >=1 at finite beta; shrinking margins alpha(beta)<1 are not excluded.
No row bound for a gauge quotient, gauge-fixed collective block kernel or physical-scale coarse action is derived here.
No obstruction to a physical mass gap is asserted; auxiliary microscopic update time is not original physical transfer time.
No large-field cluster comparison, physical trajectory, nonzero continuum candidate or finite-energy excitation is constructed.

analytic_followup_not_lean_certified.status: A separate mathematical derivation to formalize next; excluded from the 23 fresh declaration checks and from verified auxiliary evidence.
analytic_followup_not_lean_certified.existing_geometry: SU2WilsonAlignedRealization.alignedConfig realizes two independent rotating forward staples at the distinct coordinates (x,1) and (x,2) for the target (x,0); the actual staple field is 4*1+rotor(t)+rotor(s).
analytic_followup_not_lean_certified.conditional_pair: For each of the two neighbors separately, compare the all-identity configuration with the corresponding angle pi/2 rotor. These configurations differ at exactly that coordinate. Their target staple fields are A=6*1 and B=5*1+imaginaryUnit, with radii 6 and sqrt(26).
analytic_followup_not_lean_certified.discriminator: Let a=A/|A| and b=B/|B|, d=|a-b|=sqrt(2-10/sqrt(26))>0. The continuous test f(q)=|q-b|/(|q-a|+|q-b|) lies in [0,1], equals 1 at a and 0 at b. The denominator is at least d by the triangle inequality.
analytic_followup_not_lean_certified.concentration_derivation: For the Haar tilt with field A=r*a, E|q-a|^2=2*(1-axisMean(2*beta*r))<=3/(2*beta*r). Cauchy-Schwarz gives E|q-a|<=sqrt(3/(2*beta*r)). The same statement holds for B and b.
analytic_followup_not_lean_certified.influence_derivation: Since 1-f(q)<=|q-a|/d and f(q)<=|q-b|/d, the two conditional expectations differ by at least 1-K/sqrt(beta), where K=(1/2+sqrt(3/(2*sqrt(26))))/sqrt(2-10/sqrt(26)). Thus each of the two actual neighbor coefficients should satisfy this bound when the existing coordinate dictionary is connected to the discriminator estimates.
analytic_followup_not_lean_certified.row_consequence: The global LocalInfluence predicate forces all coefficients nonnegative by using the zero test with oscillation budget 1 and equal configurations. The two distinct neighbors would therefore give sum_j C((x,0),j)>=2-2*K/sqrt(beta), exceeding 1 when beta>4*K^2. This would strengthen the certified fixed-margin obstruction to failure of every global strict row contraction at sufficiently large beta.
